Method: stances are coded only from what a candidate stated (their site, plan, press release, or their own words as reported). Silence is never coded as support or opposition. Policies were chosen to cover each party's own stated agenda; Democratic nominees here generally published more policy detail online, which shows up as more 'Democrats only' rows. 'Middle' = a partial, conditional, or status-quo position. Plan detail: Detailed plan = mechanism plus specifics (numbers, named bills, step lists); Specific proposal = a concrete named policy without mechanics; Claim only = a general promise, slogan or record claim.
